body.message: The x-api-key header is required for this endpoint.
body.hint: You sent a Bearer token but /api/* endpoints require x-api-key. Bearer tokens are for /app/* endpoints (app user access to scoped data).
next_steps: For admin operations: add x-api-key header instead of Bearer
For app user data access: use /app/collections/:slug/records with your Bearer token
Get your API key at app.reqres.in/api-keys
